create_supervised_world: create a SupervisedWorld instance with a model, optimizer, tokenizer, and logger for supervised training
run_supervised_episode: run a supervised training episode on a batch and compute loss metrics including answer loss
compute_loss_with_mask: compute NLL loss on model scores with configurable token type masks for answer, question, or context tokens
train_world_batch: train a World instance on a batch with configurable updates per batch and optional eval mode
generate_answers: generate answer tokens from a batch of prompts using the model with configurable max generation length
